rules: Every cache must specify key, owner, max size, expiry, invalidation, privacy boundaries, regression tests and rollback.
Do not cache authorization decisions, signed URLs persistently, private keys, credentials, audit append results or mutable evidence bytes.
Caching never changes evidence verification semantics; immutable content may be optimized only after integrity tests.
No runtime auto-enable: candidates move from suggested to approved only after measured production-safe trial.

candidates.motivation: Repeated directory enumeration may dominate large portal trees; requires measurement
candidates.proposed: Bounded short-TTL portal-local metadata cache; invalidate on folder create/delete/move/upload, policy update and permission change

candidates.motivation: DEF-27 described duplicated fetch on opening a portal panel; first fix is deduplication, then consider cache
candidates.proposed: In-flight request deduplication; only short-lived aggregate cache with explicit refresh/invalidate
candidates.sensitivity: no IP/user identifier in cached payload

candidates.motivation: CPU-intensive work may be reusable per immutable content hash; validate against real workloads
candidates.proposed: Content-addressed cache keyed by document SHA+renderer/version/options+permission context; storage caps and secure deletion
candidates.sensitivity: document data: cache disabled unless encryption and access separation verified

candidates.motivation: Immutable versioned assets can use conditional HTTP caching
candidates.proposed: ETag and versioned asset Cache-Control; HTML and credentials remain uncached
candidates.sensitivity: never cache tokens or dynamic portal HTML as public

candidates.motivation: DEF-32 and DEF-35 describe duplicate signing and expiry tracking; cache only in caller memory while valid
candidates.proposed: Single-flight signing, expiry-aware per-session reuse with max TTL=min(signature expiry, 60s); explicit revoke invalidation

candidates.motivation: visitor-intel has file-backed data; identify repeated lookups before optimizing
candidates.proposed: Bounded in-process LRU of anonymized prefix/result; invalidate when database file mtime/hash changes
candidates.sensitivity: never store full IPs or send to remote agent

candidates.motivation: Static contracts vary with release rather than per request
candidates.proposed: Precompute during build or cache by version hash; invalidate at release
candidates.sensitivity: do not include live roles or secrets in cache
